title: wechat-ingest event
description: One ingested WeChat message, written to groups/<chatroom_id>/events.jsonl or dms/<wxid>/events.jsonl and mirrored into index.sqlite. msg_type is the mapped ingest vocabulary; unmapped WeChat types become 'raw' (never dropped).

chat_id.description: Group chatroom id or DM wxid. Folder uses chat_name when present.

chat_name.description: Human WeChat title: group name or friend remark/nickname.

msg_id.description: Message-local id; unique together with chat_id.

msg_type.description: Mapped ingest type. Unknown WeChat types are stored as 'raw' with the original type in extra_json.raw_type.

sender.description: Sender wxid; may be empty for system messages.

text.description: Message text, or placeholder like '[voice]'/'[image]' for media.

media_path.description: Path relative to the ingest root to the downloaded media file, or null when none.

extra_json.description: Raw JSON text with unmodeled payloads (raw_type, red-packet amount, reply flag, errors).

is_self.description: True when the logged-in WeChat account sent this message.
